description: In the Webots robotics simulator, save the currently loaded world to a new file location via File > Save World As.

natural_language.prompt: In the Webots robotics simulator, a simulation world is currently loaded. Your task is to save this world to a new file location. Go to File > Save World As..., then in the save dialog, navigate to '/home/ga/Documents/webots_projects/' and save the file as 'my_highway.wbt'. Make sure the file is saved successfully — you should see the new filename reflected in the Webots window title bar.
